description:
[Game reference] Building pieces by grade. One page of building pieces (every grade of every block: foundations, walls, floors, doorways, stairs,
roofs, ...), alphabetical. Each carries `slug`, `display_name`, `grade` (Twig, Wood, Stone, Metal, Armored
or Boat), `health` and `decay_hours` (how long an unmaintained piece takes to decay fully). Cached for one
hour.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the display name.
